The OG and Twitter tags ensure professional, consistent previews when shared on social platforms, driving higher click-through rates. Including the free trial mention creates immediate incentive to visit.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace for your business operations. Try 3 free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clarifies its purpose (AI assistant for trade and business), building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the risk-free trial with '3 free searches — no card required' to reduce friction and encourage first interaction.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a GDN AI member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, and annual plans save you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support—no caps, no interruptions.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel: what happens at the paywall. By transparently explaining the transition from free to paid, it builds trust, reduces abandonment, and reinforces value with specific tier pricing and benefits.
